record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=('python3_oslo_config' \n'python-cipherclient' \n'python-licenseclient' \n'python-monitorclient' \n'python-serviceclient' \n'update' \n'python3_oslo_messaging')

openEuler_RPM_spec=('recipes-base/python-oslo-config/euler/python3-oslo-config.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-cipherclient/euler/cipherclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/licenseclient/euler/licenseclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-monitorclient/euler/monitorclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/serviceclient/euler/serviceclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/cgcs-patch/euler/cgcs-patch.spec' \n'recipes-base/python-oslo-messaging/euler/python3-oslo-messaging.spec')

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7:60022/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7:60022/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#Clean up rpmbuild/
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 << eeooff
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
exit
eeooff

#Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.150.2.132
cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
    do
        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.150.2.132:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
    done

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.150.2.132:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

#build openEuler RPMs
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 << eeooff
set -o errexit
cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
rpmbuild -ba *
set +o errexit
exit
eeooff
if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
    exit 1
fi

# Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
fi

ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
scp -P60022 ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 "scp -P60022 /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
